card.name: Digit 1 or 2 where st/nd could follow
card.fires_on: The digit 1 or 2 at the start of a number or ordinal, such as a book number in a Bible citation (2 Tim., 1 Pet.), 1st graders, or the start of a multi-digit number in a dose or duration.

modes.label: Bible book numbers
modes.description: The digit 1 or 2 before an abbreviated book name like Tim., Pet., Cor.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose or duration
modes.description: A leading 1 starting a number in dosing text, such as 10 mg/kg or 12 weeks.
modes.example: Every 3 weeks for up to <<1>>2 weeks.

modes.label: Ordinal numbers
modes.description: The 1 in 1st, before the letters st.
modes.example: I always cut my strips about 1" wide for <<1>>st graders.

card.writes: It promotes ordinal endings such as st, nd and rd after a number.
card.plain: It fires on a leading 1 or 2, where the model may expect an ordinal ending like 1st or 2nd.
